posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Hello there! In a few weeks, migrant programmer and migrant artist will be visiting the UK and Ireland. I hear there are Sentinels players there. Anyone up for a game?

Here's our itinerary so far:

  • April 14 - May 15: Edinburgh (with various weekend visits around the area including Glasgow)
  • May 15 - June 12: Birmingham (as above, plus UK Games Expo June 3-5)
  • June 12 - June 19: London
  • June 19 - July 17: Dublin
  • July 17 - August 20: Paris

After that we'll be back to Canada for a while, then returning to our travels.

Let me know if you want to hang out and we'll make some plans!
